verdict.rationale: Meltano's docs say it tracks incremental replication state, so later runs with the same state ID pick up where the previous run left off. That covers the resume-from-checkpoint half of the story at the level of a whole run. The evidence says nothing about automatically retrying transient failures, or about resuming partway through an interrupted sync rather than at the next run boundary. Missing for 10: automatic retry/backoff for transient failures, documented mid-sync checkpointing on interruption, and independent or hands-on corroboration of resume behavior.
